source_requirements.label: Donkey Kong Country 3 (North America, En/Fr) headerless SNES source

presentation.manual_preparation: Select your own headerless North American English/French DKC3 .sfc. Portcove installs the checked Windows package and manages its default local saves separately from existing external copies. This build needs a short installation folder using basic Latin characters; original files can stay where they are. The reviewed v0.0.6 build had a game-logic failure during startup; later releases have not been observed running here. Gameplay, visual correctness and save/load remain unqualified.
